proposal.expected_effect: Open-endedness is supported by distinct evidence-grounded inquiry families rather than raw question count.
proposal.falsification: Reject if paraphrases inflate open-endedness or distinct evidence-grounded questions collapse incorrectly.
proposal.hypothesis: Explicit question-family tracking can distinguish genuine branching from paraphrase churn.
proposal.rollback: Revert the candidate change and restore the previous verified baseline.
proposal.selection_rationale: open_endedness was the highest eligible evidence-backed deficit (0.143) after excluding saturated dimensions, process-only adaptation, and externally blocked cognition.
proposal.test_plan: Generate paraphrases and distinct evidence-driven questions, then verify family counts distinguish them.
proposal.title: Track inquiry families across cycles
